title: One Call Property Solutions vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Landlords and managers comparing One Call Property Solutions with Precision Paint Experts: what to ask about rental turnover painting, scope, and paperwork.
h1: One Call Property Solutions vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Rental turnovers run on tight calendars. This page covers the questions property owners and managers should ask any painter before a unit goes back on the market.

questions: How fast can a rental unit be repainted between tenants?
What insurance paperwork should a property manager get from a painter?

body: One Call Property Solutions is one of the property-service companies that owners and managers in North Central Florida may be lining up against Precision Paint Experts. We are not in a position to describe anyone else's services. What we can do is set out what tends to matter on rental turnover painting, so you can ask the same things of every vendor.

Turnover work is about predictability. Vacancy days cost money, and the unit has to look clean and consistent enough to photograph and show. The painter's paperwork and scheduling matter as much as their brushwork.

sections.h2: What to confirm before the first unit
body: Ask each vendor for answers to these, ideally before you need them in a hurry:
bullets: Can you provide a certificate of insurance naming our entity before work starts?
Is every crew member covered by workers' comp?
Are the crews your own, or subcontracted?
Which product line and sheen go on walls, trim, and doors, so future touch-ups match?
How are drywall dings, nail pops, and patches handled and priced?

sections.h2: How Precision Paint Experts handles rental work
body: We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member, and a certificate of insurance naming your entity is available before mobilization. We use our own crews and do not subcontract the painting.

A single room usually takes about a day, and a whole-home interior runs from three days to two weeks depending on size and condition. Small wall damage is handled through our drywall repair and patching service, and the estimate lists which surfaces are included so there is no debate about closets or ceilings afterward. Larger portfolios fit our multi-family and apartment painting and property management painting work.

Communication is the other half of a smooth turnover. The written schedule tells your leasing team when a unit will be ready to show, and because nothing is added later without written approval, you will not find surprise line items when the invoice arrives. If a crew discovers damage that was hidden behind furniture or appliances, it is documented and sent to you for a decision before any extra work happens.

One way to cut turnover time is to settle on a standard wall color, trim color, and sheen for every unit, written into the estimate by product line. That makes touch-ups faster, and we leave labelled touch-up paint with you so maintenance staff can handle small scuffs between full repaints. Low-VOC options help when neighboring units are occupied.
Our article on choosing a paint finish covers which sheens clean up best in high-traffic rentals.

Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours and the itemized quote typically follows within one business day. Request a free estimate for a unit or a group of units and compare it with any other bid you have.

For a portfolio spread across several towns, the five-county service area covers Gainesville, Ocala, Lake City, and the smaller communities in between, so one vendor can handle units in different locations.

faqs.q: Can you name our LLC on a certificate of insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A certificate of insurance naming the client's entity is available before mobilization for property management, HOA, and commercial work.

faqs.q: How long does it take to repaint a vacant unit?
faqs.a: A single room usually takes a day. A whole interior ranges from three days to two weeks depending on size, condition, and repairs.

faqs.q: Do you use subcontractors on rental jobs?
faqs.a: No. We use our own crews and do not subcontract the work.
